name: Chamonix-Mont-Blanc
description: Chamonix is a real year-round alpine town (population 10,000), not a purpose-built resort. It sits in the shadow of Mont Blanc (4,808m) — the highest peak in Western Europe. Skiing is split across 5 separate sectors (Brevent/Flegere, Grands Montets, Le Tour/Balme, Les Houches, and the Vallee Blanche glacier descent from Aiguille du Midi). The piste total is modest (~150km) but the off-piste is the best in the Alps. The Compagnie des Guides de Chamonix (founded 1821) is the most prestigious guiding company in the Alps. The Vallee Blanche (20km, 2,800m vertical) is the most famous ski run in the world.

overview.atmosphere: Off-piste capital of the Alps. Real mountain town at the foot of Mont Blanc. 5 separate ski areas, legendary Vallee Blanche, mountaineering history since 1821.

beyond_skiing.swimming_pool_or_spa: Indoor pool at Centre Sportif Richard Bozon
beyond_skiing.ice_skating: Indoor ice rink at Centre Sportif
beyond_skiing.paragliding: Tandem flights from Brevent and other launch points — stunning Mont Blanc views
beyond_skiing.non_ski_activities: Cinema (some English screenings). Fitness centre at Centre Sportif
beyond_skiing.events_during_stay: World Mountain Bike Championships, Marathon du Mont Blanc

best_restaurants: Atmosphere (veranda over river, exceptional carpaccio, espresso martinis)
Le Cap Horn (French-Japanese fusion, hushed alpine cabin)
Le Matafan (Hotel Mont Blanc, elevated, exceptional service)
Rose du Pont (oysters, caviar, Mont Blanc views, terrace)

apres_and_nightlife.nightlife_clubbing: Micro Brasserie, Le Vermont (live music), diverse options across town. Several nightclubs for late-night dancing
apres_and_nightlife.quiet_evenings: Most varied nightlife of any French ski town. Rowdy bars, quiet wine bars, microbrewery, casino. Social and unpretentious — suits the mountaineering crowd. Not a champagne terrace scene.

villages.name: Chamonix Centre
villages.character: Real town with banks, supermarkets, shops, 100+ restaurants, bars, clubs, casino. Aiguille du Midi cable car starts from town centre. Historic quarter, 19th-century architecture.

villages.name: Les Praz
villages.character: Quiet hamlet at foot of Flegere, more peaceful, closer to Grands Montets

villages.name: Le Lavancher
villages.character: Small hamlet, limited amenities, very quiet

honest_drawbacks: Piste skiing is patchy — only ~150km across 5 disconnected sectors
Not ski-in/ski-out — each sector is a bus or drive away
Crowded lift queues at Brevent and Aiguille du Midi
Slower gondolas compared to modern systems
Valley floor altitude (1,035m) means lower snow can be thin
Can feel overwhelming — complex transport between areas

separate_ski_areas.Brevent-Flegere: Linked via cable car. Brevent has excellent intermediate cruising and the iconic Chamonix views of Mont Blanc. Flegere hides incredible off-piste couloirs with a guide.
separate_ski_areas.Grands Montets (Argentiere): Best advanced/expert terrain — steep couloirs, off-piste bowls, the famous 'Bochon' 'Chard' 'Yorkshire' and the 'Pas de Chevre' glacier run. Bluebird powder day here = best day of skiing of your life.
separate_ski_areas.Le Tour / Balme: Higher and more snow-sure. Good for intermediates, family-friendly. L'Alpage mountain farmhouse restaurant (old farmhouse, excellent cuisine).
separate_ski_areas.Les Houches: South-facing, sunny, lower altitude, family-friendly. Linked to Saint-Gervais. Good for beginners and sunny spring days.
separate_ski_areas.Vallee Blanche: 20km off-piste glacier descent from Aiguille du Midi (3,842m). The most famous ski run in the world. Guide essential. Requires fitness and good technique. Down to the valley floor at Chamonix.
separate_ski_areas.Courmayeur (Italy): Ski to Italy via the Vallee Blanche or heliski. Courmayeur is accessible from Chamonix for a day trip.

_preserved_unmapped.ski_school: Compagnie des Guides de Chamonix (founded 1821, most prestigious in Alps). Also Evolution 2 and Ski Sensations for on-piste instruction.
_preserved_unmapped.cross_border: Ski to Italy via Vallee Blanche or heliski to Courmayeur. Easy day trip to Courmayeur for Italian food and different terrain.
